title: Premada Oorali Passes 777 Charlie to Become Seventh-Highest Kannada Grosser
excerpt: The sleeper hit reached Rs 85.02 crore net in India in 26 days and crossed Rs 100 crore worldwide, after opening with Rs 9 lakh from just 60 shows.
body:
• Premada Oorali reached Rs 85.02 crore net in India in 26 days, Koimoi reported, passing 777 Charlie's Rs 84.79 crore lifetime net to become the seventh-highest-grossing Kannada film in India.
  • The film crossed Rs 100 crore worldwide: Koimoi put the total at Rs 103.17 crore, including Rs 100.32 crore gross in India and Rs 2.85 crore overseas.
  • It is a word-of-mouth outlier — it opened with Rs 9 lakh from 60 shows, then earned more in Week 3 (Rs 36.4 crore) than in Weeks 1 and 2 combined.
  • The next target is sixth-placed Su From So at Rs 92.33 crore net in India; trade trackers expect the film to finish in sixth place if the fourth-week hold continues.

The Kannada romantic drama Premada Oorali has passed Rakshit Shetty's 777 Charlie to become the seventh-highest-grossing Kannada film in India, 26 days after opening with almost no screens and almost no opening.

Koimoi reported the film earned Rs 4.25 crore net in India on Day 26, the Dussehra holiday, up from Rs 4.15 crore on its fourth Saturday. That took its India net total to Rs 85.02 crore, above 777 Charlie's lifetime Rs 84.79 crore. Koimoi put the India gross at Rs 100.32 crore and, with Rs 2.85 crore overseas, the worldwide total at Rs 103.17 crore.

A Week 3 bigger than Weeks 1 and 2 combined

The weekly pattern explains the story. Koimoi's week-wise India net figures are Week 1 at Rs 5.32 crore, Week 2 at Rs 23.65 crore and Week 3 at Rs 36.4 crore, followed by Rs 3 crore on Day 22, Rs 4.15 crore on Day 23, Rs 5 crore on Day 24, Rs 3.25 crore on Day 25 and Rs 4.25 crore on Day 26.

Sacnilk, reporting live Day 26 estimates, put the cumulative India net at Rs 84.69 crore at the time of its report and made the same Week 3 point: Rs 36.40 crore in Week 3 alone exceeded the first two weeks combined. Sacnilk also said the film had grown from 60 shows on opening day to 941 shows tracked on Day 26, despite competition from Rajinikanth's Jailer 2.

Trackers differ in method and timing, so totals vary by source and by whether a figure is net or gross. Pinkvilla, which tracks gross, reported Rs 4.25 crore on the Dussehra day, a 30% spike from the previous day, and a running India gross cume of Rs 93.25 crore at that point in its Day 26 coverage. Pinkvilla described the genre as a regular romantic comedy drama, unlike recent sleeper hits with devotional themes that followed a similar quiet-then-explosive pattern.

Where it sits in the Kannada record books

Koimoi's top-10 list for Kannada films in India, by net collection, puts KGF Chapter 2 first at Rs 859.7 crore, followed by Kantara Chapter 1 at Rs 622.48 crore, Kantara at Rs 309.64 crore, Toxic at Rs 250.13 crore and KGF Chapter 1 at Rs 185.24 crore. Su From So is sixth at Rs 92.33 crore, then Premada Oorali at Rs 85.02 crore, 777 Charlie at Rs 84.79 crore, Vikrant Rona at Rs 80.14 crore and James at Rs 76.25 crore.

Sacnilk added a separate 2026 distinction: by its live Day 26 count, Premada Oorali had become the highest Kannada-language net grosser of 2026, ahead of Toxic's Rs 63.11 crore from its Kannada version, and the second-highest Kannada release of 2026 worldwide, behind Toxic. Toxic opened large as a multilingual release; Premada Oorali built its total gradually in Kannada.

About the film

Premada Oorali is directed by Manoj Kumar and produced by Mamatha Devendra, Prashantha DS and Ramesha N under Vanilla Entertainments and Janakamma Productions, Koimoi reported. It was released on September 25. Koimoi listed the cast as Rangayana Raghu, Shree Raam, Tapaswini Poonaccha and Ramika Shivu, among others.

Pinkvilla's plot summary sets the film in a rural village, where widowed farmer Naganna wants his son Santhu to marry an educated woman. Santhu is set to marry Rukmini, an outsider who challenges village norms, while his childhood friend Vasantha holds unspoken feelings for him — a love triangle that tests his father's expectations and his own relationships.

What's next

The immediate target is arithmetic, not hype: about Rs 7.3 crore more in India net would take Premada Oorali past Su From So into sixth place, the finish Koimoi said it is likely to reach. Pinkvilla, in its gross tracking, expected the film to enter the Rs 100 crore gross club in India by the end of that week and saw potential for Rs 115-125 crore gross in a full run if the trend held. Pinkvilla's figures are trade estimates, as its own disclaimer states.
